title: Call specification for an instruction
statement: Given an instruction with $m$ registers and $d$ available deciders and a phase, define an optional call specification. It is present precisely when the instruction is a call and the phase is the start phase; it records the chosen decider, input mode, argument registers, and the positive and negative successor labels paired with the start phase. In all other cases there is no call specification.
hypotheses_covered: Natural numbers of registers $m$ and deciders $d$
